text:
alex: FYI — incident in EU control plane triggered an automated deploy gate. Holding all slots scheduled in the next 2h. Need ops decision on pin vs rollback for in-flight canaries.

dev-deploy-bot: DEPLOY BOT: Hold placed on queues. releases=[rls-20260321-42, rls-20260321-43, rls-20260321-44]; zones=[eu-west-1]; reason=control-plane-503s.

jess: which services are actually in those canaries?

alex: short list: inference-batcher (rls-42), routing-proxy (rls-43), semantic-search (rls-44). routing-proxy is on the critical path for some flows.

morgan: saw a KV cache flush ~10m ago, proxy latency jumped to ~600ms for a few mins. I'd prefer skipping the new canary for routing-proxy and pin to rls-40 for now. Non-critical canaries ok to reschedule.

sre_oncall: current error budget burn in eu-west-1 = 3.1% (15m). Control-plane 503s correlate with api-gateway SG flapping. Recommend HOLD until telemetry stabilizes. :warning:

ops-lead: Pinning critical services to the last known-good (rls-40) seems safest. For inference-batcher (rls-42) we can abort canary and push to next mid-window. I'll prepare the release note blurb and ops ticket.

jess: how do we pin quickly? is there a deploy-bot command we can run?

alex: yes — run: 
```
# pin routing-proxy to rls-40
deploy-bot pin rls-40 --service=routing-proxy --reason="incident-eu-controlplane"
```
then verify with `deploy-bot status rls-42`.

dev-deploy-bot: ACTION ACCEPTED: pin queued for routing-proxy -> rls-40 by @alex. Run ID=pin-4812340000-1.

morgan: I'll watch metrics. If error rate drops <0.5% and control plane stable in 30m we can reopen a staggered window; otherwise prepare rollback playbook.

ops-lead: I'll update release notes/changelog: "Hold/reschedule due to EU control plane incident; routing-proxy pinned to rls-40; inference-batcher canary aborted." Setting next attempt window to +2h.

sre_oncall: pinging @infra-team to investigate SG flaps on control plane. Please post when SGs stabilized. I'll update this thread with metrics.

alex: thanks everyone — temporary hold is in place. Plan: critical pins now, non-critical canaries reschedule +2h. Will post status updates and reopen this thread when we have green from SRE/infra.
